column1: # Czech (cs) catalog. Format: see the header of ja.tsv
# (context <TAB> source <TAB> translation; @id, @plural and other contexts; escapes \n \t \\).
# Plural forms (see `plural_cs` in i18n/mod.rs): one (1) | few (2–4) | other (0, 5+).
# Clean-room: written from the meaning of the English labels, following common Czech desktop
# conventions (menus are nouns, commands are infinitives); not taken from Adobe Acrobat's Czech
# localisation or any other product's translation. Terminology: annotations are "komentáře",
# pages are "stránky", form fields are "formulářová pole". Product and format names (KarnoxPDF,
# PDF, Word, HTML…) stay in Latin letters; the trailing "…" of dialog commands is kept.

column2: KarnoxPDF prints every visible sheet locally, with the paper size, margins, scale, page breaks and print titles the workbook sets. Charts, pictures and conditional formatting are not drawn yet, fonts are replaced by Helvetica, and text in scripts other than Latin cannot be converted yet. Save older .xls files as XLSX first.

Grafy, obrázky a podmíněné formátování se zatím nevykreslují, písma se nahradí písmem Helvetica a text v jiných písmech než latince zatím nelze převést. Starší soubory .xls nejprve uložte jako XLSX.
